criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: User wants to play music, songs, albums, or playlists on a media service or device.

categories.name: Get Weather
categories.definition: User requests weather information, forecasts, or specific weather conditions for a location or time.

categories.name: Book Restaurant
categories.definition: User wants to reserve a table or spot at a restaurant, brasserie, or other dining establishment.

categories.name: Rate Media
categories.definition: User wants to assign a score, rating, or stars to a book, album, series, or other media item.

categories.name: Add To Playlist
categories.definition: User wants to add a song, album, or artist to a specific music playlist.

categories.name: Find Media
categories.definition: User wants to locate, search for, or retrieve a specific book, movie, game, song, or other media item.

categories.name: Get Movie Schedule
categories.definition: User wants to find movie showtimes, schedules, or what is playing at a specific cinema or nearby.

categories.name: Watch Video
categories.definition: User wants to watch a movie, TV show, trailer, or video on a device or at a cinema.
